metadataReview.note: Add a site reference for the Chamkaur engagement: the Rupnagar district administration identifies Gurudwara Katalgarh Sahib as built where the Guru’s two elder sons and their companions fell fighting the Mughal army. The point marks that memorial site, not the full engagement area. The district page gives no date, so the existing 6 December 1704 date is retained. The page’s count of companions is not used as a strength. Strengths, losses and equipment are not inferred.

metadataReview.coordinateBasis: The Rupnagar district administration states that Gurudwara Katalgarh Sahib at Chamkaur Sahib was built at the site where Baba Ajit Singh, Baba Jhujhar Singh and their followers fell fighting against the Mughal army. The OpenStreetMap gazetteer record for this named gurdwara (way 366390453, resolved through Nominatim) gives latitude 30.8981021 and longitude 76.4128502, rounded to [76.4129,30.8981]. This is a memorial-site reference for documented fighting, not the position of the Guru’s enclosure, a surveyed Mughal position or the centre of the whole engagement. No accuracy radius is claimed.
